 UPSC UPSC Mains Result 2026 Out: Download Roll Number & Name Wise PDF
 The UPSC has not released individual Mains marks or category-wise cut-offs with the written result.
 By 
 SSBCrack 
 Last updated: November 6, 2026 
 Share 
 The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) declared the result of the Civil Services (Main) Examination 2026 on 5 November 2026. A total of 2,526 candidates have qualified for the Personality Test (Interview), the final stage of selection for the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Foreign Service (IFS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and other Central Services (Group ‘A’ and Group ‘B’).

 The written examination was conducted from 21 August to 30 August 2026. Out of the 13,343 candidates who had qualified the Preliminary Examination, approximately 18.9% advanced to the interview stage.
 Key Highlights of UPSC CSE Mains Result 2026
 Particulars Details 
 Examination Civil Services (Main) Examination 2026 
 Result Declaration Date 5 November 2026 
 Mains Exam Dates 21–30 August 2026 
 Candidates Qualified for Interview 2,526 
 Prelims Qualifiers (for Mains) 13,343 
 Result Format Roll-number-wise and Name-wise PDF 
 Next Stage Personality Test (Interview) – 275 marks 
 Written Marks for Merit 1,750 
 Final Total Marks 2,025 
 Online Form Window 11–25 November 2026 (till 6:00 PM IST) 
 Interview Venue Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi 
 Official Website upsc.gov.in / upsconline.nic.in 
 The original notification indicated approximately 933 vacancies, subject to revision.

 How to Download UPSC Mains Result 2026 PDF
 Candidates can check the result without login credentials:
 Visit the official website: upsc.gov.in.
 Navigate to the Written Results section (or check under “What’s New”).
 Locate the link titled Civil Services (Main) Examination, 2026.
 Download the roll-number-wise or name-wise PDF.
 Use Ctrl + F (or Command + F) to search for your roll number or name.
 Save the PDF for future reference.
 Direct links to the official PDFs are available on the UPSC website. The name-wise list is a detailed multi-page document.
 UPSC Mains Result 2026 Out PDF 
 Important Instructions for Qualified Candidates
 Qualified candidates must complete the following steps:
 Mandatory Online Form Submission: Log in to upsconline.nic.in between 11 November and 25 November 2026 (till 6:00 PM IST). Verify details, update if required, and submit the form. Even candidates with no changes must complete this process. Failure to do so will result in non-issuance of the e-Summon Letter.
 Candidates who had declared their educational status as “appearing” must update qualification details and upload proof.
 Original certificates supporting eligibility and reservation claims (age, educational qualifications, community, EWS, PwBD, etc.) will be verified later.
 e-Summon Letters will be available online only; no physical letters will be issued.
 Interviews will be conducted at Dholpur House, New Delhi. The schedule will be notified separately.
 Candidature remains provisional subject to verification of eligibility and documents.
 Selection Trends and Comparison
 Stage CSE 2025 CSE 2026 
 Qualified Prelims 14,161 13,343 
 Qualified Mains 2,736 2,526 
 Prelims to Mains Conversion ~19.3% ~18.9% 
 Result Declared 11 November 2025 5 November 2026 
 The number of candidates called for interview is lower than in 2025 (by 210 candidates), consistent with the relatively lower vacancy count this year. Roughly 2.5 candidates have been shortlisted per vacancy.
 Cut-off Trends (Past Years)
 The UPSC has not released individual Mains marks or category-wise cut-offs with the written result. As per established practice, mark sheets will be uploaded within 15 days of the final result declaration and will remain available for 30 days.
 For reference, recent General category Mains cut-offs (out of 1,750) have been:
 2025: 739
 2024: 729
 2023: 741
 2022: 748
 2021: 745
 These figures are indicative only. Official cut-offs for 2026 will be known only after the final result.
 Next Steps for Candidates
 For those who qualified: 
 Complete the online form submission within the stipulated window.
 Begin focused Personality Test preparation, emphasising current affairs, DAF-based questions, ethical decision-making, and clarity of thought.
 Keep all original documents ready.
 For those who did not qualify: 
 Analyse performance and identify areas for improvement.
 The next cycle (CSE 2027) notification is expected in early 2027, with the Preliminary Examination likely in May 2027.
 Conclusion
 The declaration of the UPSC Mains Result 2026 marks a significant milestone for aspirants. The 2,526 shortlisted candidates now enter the final and most crucial stage of the Civil Services Examination. Strict adherence to the form submission deadline and thorough preparation for the Personality Test will determine the final outcome.
 Candidates are advised to rely solely on official UPSC communications available at upsc.gov.in and upsconline.nic.in for the most accurate and updated information.
 All details are based on the official UPSC notice dated 5 November 2026 and contemporaneous reporting. Marks and final cut-offs remain unreleased as of the written result declaration.
